title: BOSS: The Debt Comes Due
text: Every inn, every toll, every 'borrowed' horse — it all ends up in one ledger. The Collector has found the knight. 'Fifty gold. Or we take it out of you.'

choices.label: Pay (−50g)
choices.result: The Collector marks the ledger closed with a small, disappointed nod. 'Pleasure doing business. It usually isn't.'

success.result: Three enforcers down. The Collector tears the page out himself. 'You're more trouble than you're worth.' The highest compliment the knight has ever received.

fail.result: They take the gold AND the teeth. Well. A tooth. The ledger remains open. It is never closed.

success.result: Something in the knight's eyes — the village they saved, perhaps — moves the Collector. 'One more week. ONE.' Even ledgers have margins.

fail.result: The Collector listens politely to the whole speech. Then the enforcers do their work. 'Nothing personal,' he says, and means it.

title: BOSS: The Trial of the Knight
text: The people of {location} drag the knight before a tribunal. They have heard the stories — ALL the stories. 'Defend your record,' says the magistrate. The crowd is not sympathetic.

success.result: The magistrate reads every deed aloud. By the end, the crowd is on its feet. Acquitted — and a purse is taken up for the knight's travels.

fail.result: The magistrate reads every deed aloud. It is devastating. The knight is pelted with turnips and banished. The turnips were warranted.

choices.label: Blame the voices that commanded you
choices.result: 'A thousand voices in my head MADE me do it!' The tribunal deliberates. Verdict: mad, not guilty. The knight is released. The knight hears cheering from somewhere. The knight does not look.

success.result: The knight escapes over a pile of bruised bailiffs. The stories get worse from here. They were already bad.

fail.result: There were more bailiffs than expected. There are always more bailiffs than expected.

title: BOSS: What You Have Become
text: The mirror knight returns — but it has changed. It wears every choice the knight has made. It looks tired. 'One of us gets to walk away,' it says. 'The other becomes the reflection.'

success.result: The reflection yields, and for a moment it looks relieved. 'Good,' it whispers, shattering. 'Keep going.' The knight feels stronger, and deeply strange.

fail.result: The knight wakes on the chapel floor, alone. The mirror is just a mirror. Something about the reflection's smile is different now. Smugger.

success.result: They merge without pain. Every deed, good and ill, settles into one whole person. The knight walks out of the chapel more alive than ever.

fail.result: The reflection recoils. 'No. You don't get to make peace with it THAT easily.' The knight is alone with the silence.

title: BOSS: The Last Stand at {location}
text: Raiders descend on {location}. The knight could ride away — no one would ever know. The villagers are already looking at the knight with that terrible, hopeful look.

success.result: Dawn finds the raiders broken and the knight still standing. The village will name something after the knight. Probably a goat. Still counts.

fail.result: The knight falls as the villagers escape into the hills behind them. It was enough. It was just enough.

choices.label: Ride away
choices.result: No one sees the knight leave. Everyone sees the smoke. The knight rides for a long time without stopping.

success.result: Turns out raiders have mortgages too. They accept a payout and leave. The village is saved and faintly disappointed there was no battle.

fail.result: They take the payout AND raid the village. The knight escapes with their life and a valuable lesson about raiders.
